resources.string: Could not take a screenshot. Try again in a moment.
Screen capture is not supported on this Android version. Requires Android 13+.

1. Add the app to Smart Sidebar (Settings → Smart Sidebar → customize).\n2. Pin/lock the app in recents so ColorOS keeps it running.\n3. Enable the capture service once. A sidebar tap then captures the screen and opens Google Lens.

I1 opens the translation-only camera through Google Translate; it does not capture the screen or require the capture service. H1 and H2 test Lens entry restrictions without a capture. The other buttons capture the sample text below and require the capture service. Check the visible result: an accepted launch alone does not prove that translation is selected.
